description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - proof sweep: reading a long contract or manual without skipping lines. You photograph a page, the model reads its lines, and you read line by line: tapping a line ahead marks every line you jumped over as MISSED on the spot, the page-end summary refuses to call the page done while lines are unread, and it reports a coverage percentage plus the exact missed lines to re-read. Coverage is tracked by your own step-by-step actions, never by eye tracking (which this platform does not have): a line counts as read only when you mark it read, and a skipped line is never silently forgiven. Everything lives in session memory only and is wiped when the agent closes.
name: proof-sweep
